$comment: The generic attestation set shape, published by the framework per the V1a ruling so the consumer does not invent a shape the framework may not recognize. It is a producer contract, NOT an Operator admission gate: the Operator verifies the blob's name, closure and hash mechanically, and the consumer's own semantic layer verifies self-hashes, cross-member equality and the registration join. This document deliberately knows nothing about any project's requirements -- the number of attestations, their identifiers and their per-slot pinning are the consumer's own specialization, on the same terms as the project/observation schema. No framework reader compiles against this document.

predecessor_set_id.$comment: The direct predecessor set's SHA-256 as 64 lowercase hex, or null for the first set. The chain rule itself (null only on first provision, non-null sets name the previous set's exact root hash) is enforced by the consumer generator and by the independent review, not by this schema.

attestation.$comment: One ProjectAttestation. The semantic layer recomputes attestation_id as the exact-JCS self-hash and verifies the common bundle_root_hash, plugin_id and pack/build coordinates across the set; this schema can state neither.

requirement_id.$comment: The requirement this attestation answers, named in the consumer's own taxonomy; the framework reads it as an opaque non-empty string and pins no particular spelling.

created_at.$comment: RFC 3339 timestamp; the precise shape is the producer's contract detail the semantic layer reads.
